plain_english: Having come to even-taste in You, bliss-river — may my mind drop at once this difference-based great disaster.
sanskrit_cite: tvayy ānandasarasvati samarasatām etya nātha mama cetaḥ pariharatu sakṛd iyantaṃ bhedādhīnaṃ mahānartham

plain_english: "This is mine, not this" — on passion-aversion's firm-nailed root may the axe fall inside: the certainty of oneness-with-You-made.
sanskrit_cite: etan mama na tv idam iti rāgadveṣādinigaḍadṛḍhamūle nātha bhavanmayataikyapratyayaparaśuḥ patatvantaḥ

plain_english: May the thought-stain-line melt; may unbarredness blaze in heart; bliss-rasa-flooded be my consciousness-body, Lord.
sanskrit_cite: galatu vikalpakalaṅkāvalī samullasatu hṛdi nirargalatā bhagavann ānandarasaplutāstu me cinmayī mūrtiḥ

plain_english: Me, rolled in the passion-made world-egg — may devotion-thought-mother feed me with rasas, till, wing-grown, I am a bird.
sanskrit_cite: rāgādimayabhavāṇḍakaluṭhitaṃ tvadbhaktibhāvanāmbikā tais taiḥ āpyāyayatu rasair māṃ pravṛddhapakṣo yathā bhavāmi khagaḥ

plain_english: May this mind of mine gain skill in tasting the essence of Your foot-thought-nectar-rasa — ending all object-poison-clinging-longing.
By devotion-sun-ray-touch, may this mind-jewel release far away passion-kindled fire-drops.
In that state may I praise You constantly, aloud — where even Hari, Hara's horse (?), Brahmā wait outside.
sanskrit_cite: tasmin pade bhavantaṃ satatam upaślokayeyam atyuccaiḥ hariharyaśvaviriñcā api yatra bahiḥ pratīkṣante

plain_english: By devotion-madness-born frenzy may I see with faculties unmaimed: the whole world as Śiva, and all acts as worship-stuff.
sanskrit_cite: bhaktimadajanitavibhramavaśena paśyeyam avikalaṃ karaṇaiḥ śivamayam akhilaṃ lokaṃ kriyāś ca pūjāmayī sakalāḥ

plain_english: My mind-boy, having taken Your-devotion-family-maiden, having borne aṇimā-etc. sons — may she, firm-rooted, harden the mine-thought.
